name: Gabrielle Klepfisz
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am a clinical & forensic psychologist who works with adults navigating trauma, anxiety, mood difficulties, and addictive patterns. Alongside this, I provide trauma therapy (integrating EMDR & schema therapy) to reduce symptoms and address underlying patterns that influence the present. Many of my clients are reflective, capable individuals who feel stuck in cycles that once helped but are now creating difficulties in their lives. Areas of practice: Addiction, Trauma, Pregnancy/Prenatal/Postpartum, Depression, Anxiety, Personality disorders, Eating disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse, Disturbing memories.
specialties: EMDR, Addiction, Trauma, Pregnancy/Prenatal/Postpartum, Depression, Anxiety, Personality disorders, Eating disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse, Disturbing memories

name: Ingrid Jolley
title: Social Worker
description: Ingrid works with individuals experiencing anxiety, depression, stress, grief, relationship difficulties, trauma and adjustment to life changes. This process supports healing, growth, and overall wellbeing.
